report: Day 1 is in. The X post with a number in the headline pulled the highest click-through of the campaign, about 2.5 times the LinkedIn post. The Instagram story post landed in the middle: solid likes, fewer clicks. LinkedIn got impressions but almost no engagement; the commuter audience read it and moved on. Recommendation: make numbers the default hook, lead with X, and cut LinkedIn to once a week until it earns its place.
findings: C1 hit the top CTR of the day because the headline opens with a concrete number
C3 had the most impressions but the lowest CTR; a story format without a hook does not travel on LinkedIn
Likes on C2 were strong but clicks lagged, so the CTA in bio is losing people

recommendations.action: Put a number in every headline and make X the lead channel
recommendations.why: The numbered X headline was the clear winner on CTR

recommendations.action: Rewrite the next posts to open with a figure, keep the story format for Instagram only
recommendations.why: Numbers drove clicks; stories drove likes but not clicks

recommendations.action: Move ad budget from LinkedIn to X
recommendations.why: LinkedIn had the highest cost per signup, X the lowest

message_to_team: Bram, day-1 report is on the bus: the numbered X headline won on CTR, LinkedIn story post lost. Revise the plan: numbers first, X leads, LinkedIn to weekly. Lena gets the details from you.
